title: The system identity of unattended runs in this environment (FR-IDN-004, FR-CONN-004, DEC-0015), and who may simulate events (FR-TRIG-006, DEC-0016).

teams.description: The teams whose systems unattended runs may act on.

machine_users.description: Provider -> the login of the machine user whose system connection acts for unattended runs; a merge by it never approves.

teams.description: The teams whose members may send simulated events from sdlc_ui; each must be one of `teams`.

simulation.description: Simulated events until the webhooks are set up (DEC-0016). Without it, every simulation is refused.
